parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'monitoring_active', reply: 'Surveillance proactive activée pour le train ' + $json.numero_train + ' (interrogation toutes les 10 min).', numero_train: $json.numero_train, date: $json.date, operateur: $json.operateur, threshold_minutes: $json.alert_threshold_minutes, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() } }}

parameters.body:
=<REQUEST>
  <LOGIN authenticationkey="demo" />
  <QUERY objecttype="TrainAnnouncement" schemaversion="1.6" limit="5">
    <FILTER>
      <EQ name="AdvertisedTrainIdent" value="{{ $json.numero_train }}" />
      <EQ name="Advertised" value="true" />
    </FILTER>
    <INCLUDE>AdvertisedTrainIdent</INCLUDE>
    <INCLUDE>AdvertisedTimeAtLocation</INCLUDE>
    <INCLUDE>EstimatedTimeAtLocation</INCLUDE>
    <INCLUDE>TimeAtLocation</INCLUDE>
    <INCLUDE>TrackAtLocation</INCLUDE>
    <INCLUDE>Canceled</INCLUDE>
    <INCLUDE>Deviation</INCLUDE>
  </QUERY>
</REQUEST>

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "subject": "⚠️ PERTURBATION FERROVIAIRE : Train " + $json.numero_train + " (" + ($json.is_cancelled ? 'ANNULÉ' : '+' + $json.delay_minutes + ' min') + ")",
  "body": "Pierre,

Surveillance active de votre train :
" + $json.alert_message + "
Date : " + $json.date + "
Opérateur : " + $json.operateur.toUpperCase() + "
Voie : " + $json.track + "

Jarvis reste en veille permanente sur votre itinéraire.",
  "to_email": $json.user_email
}
